evidence.observation: o2_exhaust not_installed; growth stage requires it, so the atmosphere cannot be checked
Ramp followed the setpoint closely; growth started with a +10.5 °C overshoot at 2520 s and has held 750 ± 0.4 °C since 2760 s, heater power steady at about 46%
Ar holds its 100 sccm setpoint within ±1 sccm
Pressure steady at about 760.5 Torr throughout; no pressure sign of a leak or exhaust blockage

args.missing_evidence: No exhaust O2 reading (sensor not installed). At atmospheric pressure a seal leak may not show up in pressure, so O2 contamination can't be ruled out. Fitting an O2 sensor or checking the atmosphere another way (for example a leak check) would settle this. No sample characterization exists yet.
